title: Record the null stock coefficients
body:
## Summary
- All fourteen recorded stage coefficients are null, and the boundary coefficient is null.
- The historical candidate `57604` stays in the candidate record and is not written into any stage. Both recorded stage-1 headrooms are `6562783`. No new kappa.
